lessons.title: 完形填空：My First Job Interview

questions.passage:
Last spring I had my first job interview. I was so nervous that I could hardly sleep the night __(1)__. I got up early, put on my best shirt and arrived at the company half an hour before the interview __(2)__.

The manager who interviewed me was friendly, but her questions were not easy. She asked me why I wanted the job and what I could __(3)__ to the company. I had prepared some answers at home, __(4)__ when I tried to remember them, my mind went blank. For a moment I did not know what to say.

Then I decided to stop __(5)__ to remember my prepared answers and simply tell the truth. I told her about the part-time job I had done in college and what I had __(6)__ from it. To my surprise, she smiled and asked me more questions about it.

A week later, the company called and offered me the job. That interview taught me an important __(7)__: being honest is often more __(8)__ than giving perfect answers.

Now I often tell this __(9)__ to friends who are looking for jobs. My advice is simple: prepare carefully, but do not be __(10)__ of showing who you really are.
questions.stem: Blank (1): I could hardly sleep the night ____.
questions.explain: the night before 指“前一天晚上”，即面试前一晚紧张得睡不着；“the night after”是“之后那一晚”，与第二天一早去面试矛盾。ago 不能这样放在 the night 后面。
questions.verify: 据了解，真题第六部分“完形填空”为 1 篇短文、10 处空白、4 选 1、每题 1.5 分；本课与真题空数相同（10 空），请对照最近的真题核对分值。

The morning was __(2)__ difficult. Several times I put my hand in my pocket to look for my phone, only to remember it was not there. But by lunchtime, something __(3)__ had happened. Instead of looking down at screens, people were talking to each other. My classmates and I played basketball, and I had a long conversation with a boy I had never __(4)__ to before.

In the evening I read a book for two hours without __(5)__. I noticed that I felt calmer and less tired than usual.

Of course, phones are useful, and I would not want to live __(6)__ mine. However, the experience showed me that I had been using it far too __(7)__. Now I keep my phone in a drawer while I study, and I am trying to __(8)__ more time with the people around me.

Next month our school will hold the event __(9)__, and this time I am __(10)__ forward to it.

Word bank（每个词只能用一次，有 2 个用不上）:
A. spend   B. careful   C. really   D. without   E. spoken
F. leave   G. behind   H. much   I. unusual   J. stopping
K. again   L. looking
questions.stem: Blank (9): Next month our school will hold the event ____.（从词库选词，填单词或字母）
questions.explain: 句子成分已经完整，空格处只能填副词；学校下个月要“再”办一次无手机日，用 again，后面的 this time（这一次）也说明不是第一次办。

lessons.title: 填句补文：Making Friends in a New City

questions.passage:
Making Friends in a New City

Moving to a new city can be exciting, but it can also be lonely. __(1)__ Here are a few ideas that may help.

First, say yes to invitations. When a colleague asks you to lunch, go, even if you are tired. __(2)__

Second, join a club or class. It could be a running club, a cooking class or a language group. __(3)__ Seeing the same faces every week makes it easy to start a conversation.

Third, be patient. Real friendships do not develop overnight. __(4)__ So do not give up if the first few weeks are quiet.

Finally, remember that many other people in the city are also looking for friends. __(5)__ A simple "Hi, I'm new here" can be the start of a long friendship.
questions.stem: Blank (1) of 'Making Friends in a New City': which sentence fits best?
options: Most big cities have excellent public transportation.
Small meetings like this often lead to friendships.
People who share a hobby always have things to talk about.
Many newcomers do not know how to meet people.
questions.explain: 空格前说搬到新城市可能很孤独，空格后是“下面几个办法也许有帮助”，中间要先引出问题：很多新来的人不知道怎样结识别人。“Small meetings like this…”里的 like this 在这里没有可指代的内容。
questions.verify: 据了解，真题第四部分“填句补文”为 1 篇短文、5 处空白、从 6 个句子中选 5 个、每题 2 分；本课改成每题 4 选 1，请对照最近的真题核对。
